dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear-segmented trailing edge with minimal concave curvature from the apex to the posterior base, represented by low-polygon mesh facets.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex point with near-zero pixel radius at the maximum vertical morphological extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree upward slope relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 base-width to maximum vertical-height ratio.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Segmented convex arc defined by distinct polygon facets along the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1.5:1 from the inflection point to the anterior tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees where the melon slope transitions into the dorsal rostrum surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible low-polygon geometric mesh topology across the entire body surface; uniform cyan digital texture with simple flat-shading.
